thread:
Maya Chen: Quick preflight for launch + webinar funnel. Need final SEO checklist: redirects, JSON-LD for Article + Report, two internal CTA anchor variants (A/B), canonical normalization (strip utm_source/medium), and GTM events. Who takes what?
Samir Patel: Ill take redirects and infra. Proposal: 302 for 10 days to monitor click/engagement, then 301. Add Cache-Control: max-age=300 during test. Example nginx snippet:```location ~ ^/old-launch/(.*)$ {
  add_header Cache-Control \"max-age=300\";
  return 302 https://redwood.com/launch/$1$is_args$args;
}
# server-side middleware will drop utm_source and utm_medium from canonical generation
```
Olivia Park: Schema work here. We'll add Article JSON-LD for each blog post and Report schema for the gated benchmark PDF. Minimal Report schema sample to include in PR:```{
  \"@context\": \"https://schema.org\",
  \"@type\": \"Report\",
  \"name\": \"Redwood Launch Benchmark 2026\",
  \"author\": {\"@type\": \"Organization\", \"name\": \"Redwood Inference\"},
  \"url\": \"https://redwood.com/reports/launch-benchmark\",
  \"isAccessibleForFree\": \"False\"
}```Ill run Rich Results test and post result.
Priya Nair: Internal linking plan: update 5 priority posts. We'll A/B the anchor text on half: Variant A = \"Download the Redwood launch benchmark\" (anchors to gated form), Variant B = \"See the full benchmark\". Add a contextual CTA after the second H2 and a summary CTA at top. Also update hub page to include canonical rel pointing to launch hub. Avoid canonical on paginated tag pages.
Jeff Ramos: GTM/events: create two events: `launch_benchmark_cta_click` with variant label (A/B) and `benchmark_form_impression` (fired on form load). We'll include dataLayer snippet in PR and set up a test GA property. Also we'll keep utm_campaign in analytics but strip utm_source/medium from canonical URL.
Nora Liu: CRO note we should add hidden field to form for anchor variant and pass it through to mixpanel for cohorting. Ill add to form PR.
Maya Chen: Agree on 10-day window. Samir add smoke script (curl follow redirects + check cache header + verify location) and link CI job.
Samir Patel: Will add smoke test: `curl -I -L -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code} %{redirect_url} %{size_download}\"` and a small ruby script to confirm header and status flips.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy: seo-launch-anchors branch deployed at 1715010200 all tests green :white_check_mark:.
Olivia Park: Rich Results test passed for article snippet, Report schema flagged as non-indexable due to gated asset (expected). Screaming Frog crawl shows no orphaned paginated canonical issues. Posting screenshots to the PR.
Priya Nair: PR opened with copy + anchor variants + canonical updates. Tagging @Maya for final content QA.
Jeff Ramos: DataLayer example in PR:```window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'launch_benchmark_cta_click', variant: 'A' });```
Maya Chen: Great. Plan: flip to 301 after 10 days if metrics stable. Schedule 15m follow-up 24h after PR merge to validate events & drops in 302s. Anyone else?
Nora Liu: I'll instrument the form for variant tracking and confirm events in staging.
Samir Patel: Deploy will include a toggle in infra config to flip redirects, so we can revert quickly if we see crawl errors.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. No blockers, merge when green. :rocket:
